title: Gram Prime
extract:
Gram Prime is the Primed variant of the  Gram heavy sword, possessing the highest offensive stats of all heavy blades thanks to a large increase to damage, critical chance, critical multiplier, and status chance, but also rendered the slowest due to a steep reduction to attack speed. It was released alongside  Chroma Prime and  Rubico Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
 stance polarity matches  Cleaving Whirlwind and  Tempo Royale.
Two innate  polarities.
Melee Stance slams without the full slam visual, such as those from  Cleaving Whirlwind's Sundered Tusk combo, have their damage multiplied by Melee Combo and have the ability to crit.
Melee stance slams with the full slam visual have the ability to crit, but do not have their damage multiplied by Melee Combo.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Second highest base damage of all heavy blades, behind  Vitrica.
Second highest critical chance of all heavy blades, behind  Tenet Exec.
Tied with  Paracesis and  War for the second highest critical multiplier of all heavy blades, behind  Sarofang Prime.
Second highest status chance of all heavy blades, behind  Vitrica.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On June 30th, 2020, it was announced that Gram Prime, alongside  Chroma Prime and  Rubico Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on July 14th, 2020. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.

Notes
Under Heavy Blades, the Melee Combo dependent damage multiplier and ability to deal critical hits on Melee Stance 'mini' slams is only shared by  Masseter,  Masseter Prime and  Paracesis
On other weapons, these hits only deal minimal damage as they are unaffected by mods other than  Seismic Wave.

Trivia
Gram Prime was first revealed in TennoCon 2018's Art Panel on July 7th.
